final: SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count, AVG(AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate)) OVER () AS plain_avg_scope_rate, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) - AVG(AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate)) OVER () AS deviation_from_plain_avg FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope
